scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api "npm run dev -w @careledger/web" "npm run dev -w @careledger/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @careledger/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @careledger/api && npm run build -w @careledger/web
scripts.build:demo: npm run build -w @careledger/shared && npm run build:demo -w @careledger/web
scripts.setup: npm run build -w @careledger/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @careledger/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
